toolsResidualRound2.noNamedGateways: No named gateways yet. Create one here, then issue a token for the client that will connect to it.
toolsResidualRound2.invalidJson: That doesn't look like valid JSON yet — paste the whole snippet, including the outer braces.
toolsResidualRound2.pasteDescription: Paste the MCP config snippet from the tool's README and we'll turn it into a friendly setup.
toolsResidualRound2.pasteHint: Paste an MCP config — the snippet a README tells you to copy.
toolsResidualRound2.readBeforeSaved: We'll read it and show what we found before anything is saved.
toolsResidualRound2.noAppFound: We couldn't find an app in that config. Double-check you pasted the whole snippet.
toolsResidualRound2.foundApps: We found {{count}} app{{suffix}} in that config
toolsResidualRound2.remoteCheckDescription: Checking a remote app creates a draft connection, stores any header replacements as Paperclip secrets, and runs health/catalog discovery before activation.
toolsResidualRound2.localDraftDescription: We humanized the field names from the config. These run-in-your-workspace tools stay as drafts until an admin maps them to an approved template.
toolsResidualRound2.draftKeysDescription: Keys from this config stay draft-only until an admin maps them to an approved template.
toolsResidualRound2.reviewActionsDescription: Health and catalog checks passed. Read-only actions start on; actions that can change data start off.
toolsResidualRound2.connectionDescription: Choose an existing application or create one as part of the same connection flow. Credentials stay as vault references and the connection is probed before activation.
toolsResidualRound2.approvedTemplatesOnly: Only board-approved command templates can run. Arbitrary commands are never accepted.
toolsResidualRound2.applicationTypeInferred: Application type is inferred from the transport you choose next.
toolsResidualRound2.freeTextSecrets: Free-text secrets are not accepted — pick a vault entry; Paperclip stores only the vault:// reference and resolves it at gateway use time.
toolsResidualRound2.probeLatencyDescription: Probe latency is a single round-trip sample. Aggregate p95 latency across traffic is tracked on the Runtime tab once the connection is live.
toolsResidualRound2.profilesAdminBodyBeforeLink: Access profiles decide which tools your agents can use. Ask an administrator to set these up, or head back to
toolsResidualRound2.profileDescription: Choose which tools this profile allows, then assign it to the agents that need them.
